review.questionCheck: From a=(3/2)b, we obtain 3b=2a, so the requested percentage is 200. Choice D and the key agree; there are no figure conflicts.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: No shared-bank methods were supplied. The LIVE proportional calculation and Random Math first solution are represented by double-the-given-relation. Random Math's second solution is retained as choose-one-hundred. Both accessible perspectives are covered.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Multiplying a=(3/2)b by 2 gives 2a=3b. Thus 3b is 200 percent of a, as claimed.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: The cited LIVE and Random Math first solutions support this exact proportional argument. Third-party attribution and source-informed-original classification are accurate.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The conversion from 150 percent to 3/2 explains why doubling is the useful first move.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_p197 directly covers expressing 3b as a percentage of a; the simple rearrangement needs no additional node.
